# Teltonika RMS Provider

Provider for the Teltonika RMS API (https://developers.rms.teltonika-networks.com).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    teltonika = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/lombare/teltonika-rms"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "teltonika" {
  # Alternatively set TELTONIKA_RMS_TOKEN in the environment.
  token = var.teltonika_rms_token
}

variable "teltonika_rms_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Override for the RMS API base URL. Defaults to https://rms.teltonika-networks.com/api; TELTONIKA_RMS_BASE_URL is honoured if set.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token for the RMS API (Bearer). May also be set via the TELTONIKA_RMS_TOKEN environment variable.
